_comment: Charged techs (issue #8). With a full power gauge, hold Attack for about a second: the hero glows, chimes when ready, and releasing fires the tech. Letting go early is a normal full-power swing. Keyed by hero id (data/heroes.json). mult: damage as a multiple of the hero's full-power swing, so levels, gear and research carry over. reach: radius in px. arc: degrees either side of facing (180 = all round). offset: the blast is centred this many px in front of the hero (0 = on the hero). knock: knockback force. heal: optional HP patched onto every ally inside the blast. step: px the hero lunges forward as it fires. color: glow and blast colour.

ash.name: Full Stop
ash.desc: Ash jabs the quill-knife into the page and the full stop bursts: a blast just in front that hits everything around it.

bran.name: Breach of Contract
bran.desc: Bran stops negotiating. A huge, slow cleaver arc in front of him that sends Nibblers flying.

gristle.name: Stir the Pot
gristle.desc: A full turn of the bone ladle. Hits everything around her and splashes allies inside with 6 HP of broth.

ninefingers.name: Skewer
ninefingers.desc: Daro lunges the full length of the pike. A very long, very narrow line that hits hardest of all. Aim it.
